# Fallback only. The live robots.txt is generated by robots.php, which
# .htaccess rewrites this address to, so the Sitemap line below can name
# the real domain. This static copy is what gets served if the rewrite is
# ever unavailable, so it stays deliberately conservative.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /documents/
Disallow: /config/
Disallow: /includes/
Disallow: /sql/
Disallow: /vendor/
Disallow: /track.php?tn=
Allow: /track.php
Allow: /
